[F012] The F012 implementation is complete and verified. Summary below.

I found the F012 model pass-through fully implemented in the working tree (including iteration-1 fixes responding to codex audit findings) and verified it end to end rather than re-implementing. `DispatchTask` in `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/executors/base.py:82` carries `model: str | None = None`; `claude_cli.py` appends `--model <id>` after permission flags and `codex_cli.py` inserts it as an `exec`-subcommand option, both only when set, so the unset path leaves pre-F012 argv byte-identical. Config supports a `models` block on both `GlobalConfig` and `ProjectConfig` (project wins over global) plus object-shaped `roles` entries with per-role model, resolved harness-aware by `resolve_model`/`resolve_goal_audit_model` in `config/resolvers.py` — cross-vendor overrides are suppressed when the resolved harness differs. The supervisor forwards the resolved model at both dispatch seams (`supervisor.py:1236` and `supervisor.py:3508`), and the goal-audit paths in `sufficiency_auditor.py` and `completion_dispatch.py` forward it too; `model_version` already lands in audit records via the Claude executor's `modelUsage` parsing. The targeted suite `tests/test_f012_model_passthrough.py` (37 tests) covers both acceptance cases — unset preserves argv, set adds the vendor flag — plus layering, precedence, and cross-vendor suppression, and passes clean: 37 passed in 0.29s.

$ python3 -m pytest scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/te
